claims.statement: Construction and demolition waste exceeds one third of EU waste, and selective demolition and audits are promoted to remove hazards and enable reuse and higher-quality recovery.
The EU protocol and audit guidance are non-binding, and JRC states that pre-demolition audits are not generally mandatory in the assessed baseline.
Polish law effective 1 January 2025 requires separation of specified construction and demolition waste fractions and permits written delegation to an authorised entity with joint responsibility.

Used construction products can fall under the new Construction Products Regulation, whereas direct reuse in a construction work is not treated as a fresh placing on the market; this makes route-specific legal classification essential.
If a lot is waste and the service acts as a waste-market intermediary, BDO registration and waste records may apply even without physical possession.
JRC reports audit costs of roughly EUR 3000-5000 for demolition projects up to EUR 300000, but also reports uncertain economic effectiveness and burden for small sites.
Concular already offers the closest full-stack substitute, including audits, digital inventory, marketplace distribution, logistics, and insured or warranted installation support.
Greyn and RAEDIFICARE show that listings can be free or no-commission; RAEDIFICARE's published 2024 marketplace figures imply about EUR 714 per order, making percentage-only economics fragile.
The EU is considering mandatory digital pre-demolition audits and a connected European data platform, which could increase inventory supply but reduce proprietary control of listings.
No reviewed evidence establishes Polish buyer density, recoverable value per project, owner purchase intent, or insurer acceptance for the proposed model.

contrary_evidence: The audit guidance is not a general legal purchase mandate.
Small-site economics can be negative and audit effectiveness is not established.
Concular already integrates nearly the entire proposed workflow.
Free and no-commission marketplaces reduce room for a 5-8% general take rate.
Construction-product, waste, BDO, hazardous-material, and warranty duties remain lot-specific.
EU public data infrastructure could weaken exclusive inventory as a moat.
